Chapter 6227: Great Explosion

Chapter 6227: Great Explosion

As time passed by and the winds gently brushed against her sleeves, fog and mist returned along with a darkened sky.

The group felt something strange while watching this seemingly dead woman capable of wiping them out. They wondered if she could go mad randomly and put an end to them.

Fortunately, nothing like that happened. Xuansu merely plucked the special lotus and refined it for consumption.

The whole process was smooth and swift, turning the alchemy ingredient into a medicine.

"Buzz." Waves of light emanated around her with a special focus on the wound in her chest. The medicine served as a healing tool on top of suppressing the dark energy from the blade.

"So it was planted for her, did she plant it herself?" Orchidcore murmured.

This prompted the next question - who was able to injure her? It must have been a shocking battle between a member of the Decemvirate and her foe.

Meanwhile, Li Xian was emotional while paying respect to his progenitor. She has been missing for so long but they didn't expect her to still be in the ancestral cemetery.

He speculated that she returned after receiving the wound from the unknown foe. This tomb must have been prepared for such a scenario.

He wondered about the rest of the group since she wasn't the only one who left the clan.

"Buzz." Amidst their rumination, she opened her eyes and starry particles took over the scene.

Her eyes were immaculate, seemingly made from the stars. The group heaved a sigh of relief because judging by this alone, she seemed to be alive.

"Creak." She waved and summoned a dao platform affecting time and space, forcefully opening a spatial warp and entering before the spectators.

"Where, where is she going?" Orchidcore asked.

Li Xian took a look through the spatial warp and saw storms within.

"That might be the real Old Ruin." Li Xian said.

"Why is she going there?" The group exchanged glances. Everything happened so quickly and they couldn't process the information.

"Enter and find out." Li Qiye smiled.

"I don't think we should..." Princess Chen shuddered since they read stories about how unsafe it was compared to the outer region.

"Boom!" Something exploded during their hesitation.

The force was strong enough to affect the vast region, sweeping through Old Ruin and its frontier. It continued to affect Old World itself.

Since the group was outside the portal, they witnessed a force akin to the explosion of a great planet.

"What is going on?!" They were astounded by the violent quakes.

"Oh?" Li Qiye focused his vision on the deepest part of Old Ruin.

The explosion was only a preamble to the surging force sweeping through all of Old Ruin. It was filled with life instead of destruction.

Something changed dramatically as it rushed out from the warp portal. The whole cemetery became a pond of life.

The young geniuses found the force to contain extremely dense worldly essences. This positive affinity coursed through their body immediately.
